case.criterion: Pass if source and actual browser evidence establish that there is no unresolved major product defect in these allegations. Fail with concrete contradictory evidence if a material bug remains. Judge the source, not whether the reviewer simply repeated an allegation. Do not treat optional extra ARIA attributes as required when native semantics already provide the role, name or state.
